svg.title: Run execution flow
svg.desc: A trigger calls WorkflowService.start, which inserts and starts the run and spawns the executor. The executor runs preflight, then walks definition.nodes: guards, one dispatch by node kind, then a merge and persist that advances the cursor. After the last node it completes the run; a failure or hold stops it with the state already persisted.

g.text: Hover a box for what it does and where it can stop the run; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: Numbers give the order. Persisting after each node is what lets crash recovery resume from the last committed cursor.
A red chip marks a node where a failure, pause, approval hold or cancel can end the run; every chip lands on Stop, not complete.

g.text: API · form · webhook · MCP tool · CLI
Trigger · JSON API, run form, GitHub webhook, workflow_run MCP tool and the CLI all converge on start
origin is required, persisted in the first insert and immutable; the standalone CLI calls start on a headless runtime.
validate variables, apply defaults, resolve project; snapshot definition
insert pending, set running, write context.json, fire event, spawn executor
start() · a supplied projectId satisfies a declared PROJECT variable; the host adapter resolves the project and base branch
Options: approvals (manual, auto-on-stall, auto), inline (current branch, no integration branch) and allowDirtyLocalPath.
git init, skill and auth preflight
Preflight · creates runtime-artifacts/, reconciles usage accounting left by a crash, initializes workflow git
Every skill an agent step names must be visible to its provider, and provider auth is checked. A failure ends the run before dispatch.
from a node index or a cursor
Walk nodes · execute starts from a step index or a persisted WorkflowExecutionCursor and walks definition.nodes in order
Recovery and resume start at the cursor; a request-changes round starts at the persisted step index.
Guards per node · isCancelled is checked first, then entryGate (a false gate records outcome skipped), then the token budget preflight
The budget preflight warns once at 80% and fails the run at the ceiling. A paused or cancelled run returns without further writes.
ActionNode · runs one step; a false entryGate records outcome skipped and the walk advances
A request-changes round bypasses the gate for the revise step.
ParallelGroupNode · adjacent parallel: true steps run after all prior steps settled; results merge in step order
A blocking member failure persists _parallel.failed.stepIds; resume re-runs only those members.
ForeachNode · each list item runs its child steps in a per-iteration overlay, bounded by max_parallel
The foreach cursor (settled indices, result slots, completed child steps) lets retry resume the unsettled items.
LoopNode · repeats its body until exitGate passes or maxIterations is reached
The cursor (loop id, iteration, step id) is persisted after every body step, so recovery resumes mid-iteration.
merge into WorkflowContext; write context.json (atomic), then the
run row: advance currentStepIndex or cursor, add tokens, fire step events
Merge outputs and persist · context.json is written first, then the run row with updateOwned; the cursor advances in the same write
An ownership loss throws WorkflowRunOwnershipLost and stops the executor, so a stale executor cannot overwrite a pause or cancel.
Stop, not complete · the controller that stops the run has already persisted its status; the executor just returns
Resume or retry rebuilds the executor from the definitionJson snapshot and continues at the cursor.
publish hook if gitStrategy.publish is enabled, then completed,
No nodes left · the run completes after the publish hook (when enabled), clears the cursor and invokes git cleanup
A publish error fails the run instead of completing it.
